starting-out.speaker: Herman Caranos
starting-out.text: Lovely? Oh - er - if you say so. But please excuse me, I really don't have time to chat about the weather.

starting-out.prompt: What would you like to say?

options.text: What's the rush?

steps.player: What's the rush?

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Trolls! They're attacking my fishing Colony!

steps.player: Gosh, I didn't know there were any trolls around here.

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: These are a sort of sea-dwelling troll. They feed on the monkfish that live in this part of the sea, but just recently they've started invading my Colony!

options.text: Do you need any help?

steps.player: Do you need any help?

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Well yes, I do. I've done some research about this, and I think our best hope is to get hold of an experienced adventurer.

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: In all the legends I've read, brave adventurers have no trouble vanquishing whatever monsters are menacing the helpless settlement.

options.text: You've been... reading stories about adventurers?

steps.player: You've been... reading stories about adventurers?

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Yes, I've done my research very carefully. I've always made important decisions based on careful analysis of whatever documents are available to me on the topic. For example, I chose this site for my Fishing Colony because

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: records show this part of the sea to be a prime site for catching monkfish. I don't just fumble along like an amateur!

steps.player: ... fair enough, I suppose! Anyway, you think you need an adventurer?

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Yes, that's right. A brave adventurer with plenty of experience in this sort of work.

options.text: I'm a brave adventurer! Can I try?

steps.player: I'm a brave adventurer! Can I try?

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: You? I hadn't thought of that... let's have a look at you...
If the player does not meet the quest requirements:

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: No, I'm sorry, but you simply do not have enough experience. I've got a LOT at stake here, and I can't afford to have an amateur getting in the way.

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Hmmm... You're not what I'm looking for, but... [amount] Quest Points is really rather a lot...

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Ok, the Piscatoris Fishing Colony gratefully accepts your offer of help. When the Colony is safe you shall be handsomely rewarded.

steps.player: Oh goody, I love rewards! Now, how can I help?

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Well, as qualified as you undoubtedly are, I believe we're going to need a truly expert adventurer if the Colony is to stand a chance.
If the player has not completed Legends' Quest:

steps.player: Expert adventurer? I'll wager I've had more adventures than you've had pickled gherkins!

steps.text: If the player has completed Legends' Quest:

steps.player: Expert adventurer? I'll have you know I'm in the Guild of Legends!

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: If you could just stop blowing your own trumpet for a minute...

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Excellent! Now, in far-away Misthalin there lives one of the greatest adventurers of all time.

steps.player: ... this better be good...

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: His name is lost in the mists of time, but you shouldn't have much trouble finding the Wise Old Man of Draynor Village.
If the player has either spoken to the Wise Old Man before or watched the Draynor bank robbery:

steps.player: Him? What in the heck do you want with HIM?

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Oh, do you know him?
If the player does not know he robbed the bank:

steps.player: Well I've met him. Don't you think he's a bit old?

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Maybe, but he's still an expert adventurer.
If the player knows he robbed the bank:

steps.player: Yes! He's mad! You know he smashed his way into a bank and stole a load of stuff?

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Ah well, we must forgive him his little foibles.
If the player somehow bypasses the condition of having spoken to the Wise Old Man (normally impossible due to Garden of Tranquillity being required for this quest):

steps.player: He's just called 'Wise Old Man'?

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Well, he presumably has a name, but that's what he's called now.

steps.player: And you want me to fetch this Wise Old Man?

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: You don't sound convinced. Look, I'll tell you what I've read about him...
A cutscene shows him killing an ogre shaman

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Take THAT!

steps.speaker: Ogre Shaman
steps.text: Ssssss!
The cutscene changes to show him killing the drunken dwarf

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: 'Ello matey!

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: Don't ignore your mate!

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: Hey, matey!

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: I AM NOT YOUR MATE!
The cutscene changes to show him killing the Shaikahan

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Aaah!

steps.speaker: Shaikahan
steps.text: RAAAaaarrgh!

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Lie still, and trouble us no more.
The cutscene changes to show him fighting the Kalphite Queen

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Avaunt, foul fiend!.

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Oh deary me...
The cutscene changes to show him fighting Dad but he gets knocked back, smashing the camera and ending the cutscene

steps.player: Right... so you want me to fetch this old man who used to be a great adventurer.

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Yes, that's right. And do watch out for the sea trolls!

options.text: I'll leave you to it, then.
I'll leave you to it, then.
I'll leave you to it, then.

steps.player: I'll leave you to it, then.

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Fine, fine.

starting-out-talking-to-herman-again.speaker: Herman Caranos
starting-out-talking-to-herman-again.text: Ah, [player name]. I was wondering where you'd got to.

starting-out-talking-to-herman-again.player: What was it you wanted me to do?

starting-out-talking-to-herman-again.speaker: Herman Caranos
starting-out-talking-to-herman-again.text: Go to Draynor Village and fetch the Wise Old Man to help save the Colony!

starting-out-talking-to-herman-again.player: Couldn't I just save it myself?

starting-out-talking-to-herman-again.speaker: Herman Caranos
starting-out-talking-to-herman-again.text: No! Now go and do what I told you!

options.text: You used to be a famous adventurer, didn't you?

steps.player: You used to be a famous adventurer, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Heh heh! Yes, I suppose you could say that. But that was all quite a long time ago. I haven't been on what you'd call a 'quest' for a while.

steps.player: Does that mean you'd be interested if someone asked for your help?

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Oh? What exactly had you in mind?

steps.player: Herman Caranos of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony thinks he needs you to save his colony from a tribe of attacking sea trolls.

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Hmmm... so I haven't been forgotten... and the world once again is calling for my aid...

steps.player: Well, it's just one man who smells of fish, not exactly the whole world...

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: ... yet this could be the opportunity I've been waiting for...

steps.player: ... yawn...

steps.text: The player performs the Yawn emote

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: ... but I'm a lot older than I used to be, do I still have the strength? Should I retire now, or can I do just one more quest?

steps.player: If you're not feeling up to it, I'll leave you alone.

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Yes, I'll do it! This can be my final adventure, my last great quest. Saving this colony shall be my swan song.

steps.player: Swan song?

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Legend tells us that a swan, before it dies, sings a song of outstanding beauty as a fitting conclusion to its graceful life. This adventure will be my swan song.

steps.player: You're going to sing a song and then snuff it? Maybe I should tell Herman you've flipped...

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: No, you ignoramus! I shall bring my adventuring days to a dramatic close by saving this colony!

steps.player: Great. So long as you're not going to sing.

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Yes, that's right, I'm not going to sing. Anyway, I shall need some supplies from you.

steps.player: Oh yes? What do you want?

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: I'm rather short of runes. If you could fetch me 5 Blood runes, 10 Lava runes and 10 Mist runes, I'll be able to set off.
If player already has them with them:

steps.player: I just happen to have those with me!

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Gosh, you're very efficient!

steps.player: Sometimes I amaze even myself.

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Ok, hand 'em over.

steps.player: Here you go...

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Excellent. I'll see you outside the Colony. Don't forget to arm yourself - it could be dangerous!
The Wise Old Man teleports away
If the player does not have the required runes:

steps.player: Right, 5 Blood runes, 10 Lava runes and 10 Mist runes.

options.text: More...
You asked me to get some runes.

steps.player: You asked me to get some runes.

steps.text: If the player is carrying all the runes:

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Okay, hand 'em over.

steps.player: Here you go...

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Excellent. I'll see you outside the Colony. Don't forget to arm yourself - it could be dangerous!
The Wise Old Man teleports away
If the player does not have all of the required runes:

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: I'm guessing you haven't got them all, have you?

steps.player: No, not yet.

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Well, do get a move on! I need 5 Blood runes, 10 Lava runes and 10 Mist runes, otherwise I'll be no use in a fight.

options.text: More...

returning-to-the-colony.speaker: Wise Old Man
returning-to-the-colony.text: Hello again, [player name]! I must thank you for persuading me to come - I feel quite invigorated in the sea breeze!

returning-to-the-colony.player: Oh - er - good. Well, Herman must be inside the Colony now, so we should probably go in.

returning-to-the-colony.speaker: Wise Old Man
returning-to-the-colony.text: Are you sure you're ready? I can hear creatures moving around in the trees, and we might have to do some fighting soon.

options.text: I'm ready to fight.

steps.player: I'm ready to fight.

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Excellent. I think this little tunnel will lead us there...

options.text: I should go and get ready first.

steps.player: I should go and get ready first.

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Yes, better safe than sorry! We can go through this little tunnel when you're ready.

returning-to-the-colony-talking-to-the-w.speaker: Wise Old Man
returning-to-the-colony-talking-to-the-w.text: Just hop into the tunnel when you're ready.

outside-the-colony-right-after-entering-.text: Sea trolls emerge from the sea

outside-the-colony-speaking-to-the-wise-.speaker: Wise Old Man
outside-the-colony-speaking-to-the-wise-.text: Well, it all seems to have gone smoothly so far!

inside-the-colony-after-entering-the-col.speaker: Wise Old Man
inside-the-colony-after-entering-the-col.text: Please go and tell Herman I'm here. Someone's sure to know where to find him.
The Wise Old Man teleports away

inside-the-colony-talking-to-franklin.speaker: Franklin Caranos
inside-the-colony-talking-to-franklin.text: Ah, [player name]! Herman told me to expect you. You'll find him in his office by the eastern wall of the Colony.

inside-the-colony-talking-to-arnold.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
inside-the-colony-talking-to-arnold.text: So, [player name]! I did hear from Herr Caranos that you were to our Colony coming. The Director in his office is waiting for you.

inside-the-colony-attempting-bank-with-a.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
inside-the-colony-attempting-bank-with-a.text: No way can I send items to bank for you with great big trolls outside! You save Colony, then Arnold open bank for you.

inside-the-colony-attempting-to-trade-wi.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
inside-the-colony-attempting-to-trade-wi.text: I not have spare stuff to trade with you now. Maybe we trade after you save Colony, ja?

inside-the-colony-attempting-to-collect-.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
inside-the-colony-attempting-to-collect-.text: No way can I let you collect stuffsies with great big trolls outside! You save Colony, then Arnold help you.

inside-the-colony-using-the-poll-booth.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
inside-the-colony-using-the-poll-booth.text: That thing broken. Arnold fix it when Colony all safe.

inside-the-colony-using-the-deposit-box.text: There are big trolls outside, focus your attention on that instead of trying to deposit items!

inside-the-colony-searching-herman-s-des.text: Amongst the papers on Herman's desk is a book. You 'borrow' it.

inside-the-colony-talking-to-herman.speaker: Herman Caranos
inside-the-colony-talking-to-herman.text: Finally you've arrived! Did you bring the Wise Old Man?
The Wise Old Man teleports in

inside-the-colony-talking-to-herman.speaker: Herman Caranos
inside-the-colony-talking-to-herman.text: Excellent! You have no idea how grateful I am!

inside-the-colony-talking-to-herman.player: Talking of gratitude, I believe you mentioned some kind of reward...

inside-the-colony-talking-to-herman.speaker: Herman Caranos
inside-the-colony-talking-to-herman.text: Reward? Well... we've got to discuss the Colony's defences now. Perhaps you could go and make yourself useful around the Colony? I'm sure my brother, Franklin, could do with a bit of help. Arnold, the storemaster, said he needed an extra pair of hands too. He's in one of the big storage sheds.

inside-the-colony-talking-to-herman.player: Ok, I help out, then I get a reward?

inside-the-colony-talking-to-herman.speaker: Herman Caranos
inside-the-colony-talking-to-herman.text: Yes, yes... now please excuse us.

inside-the-colony-talking-to-herman-agai.text: The player performs the Wave emote

inside-the-colony-talking-to-herman-agai.speaker: Herman Caranos
inside-the-colony-talking-to-herman-agai.text: [player name]? Have you helped Franklin and Arnold yet?
If the player hasn't helped either of them:

steps.player: No, I haven't.

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Please do so!

inside-the-colony-talking-to-herman-agai.text: If the player has started helping either of them:

steps.player: I'm on the case, no problems.

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: That's what I like to hear. Off you go...

helping-franklin.player: Herman said you wanted a hand with something.

helping-franklin.speaker: Franklin Caranos
helping-franklin.text: Well, yes, I do. Are you any good at smithing?

helping-franklin.player: Oh yes, I'm quite an expert.

helping-franklin.speaker: Franklin Caranos
helping-franklin.text: Ok, we'll see. Now, the trolls managed to smash part of our western wall earlier today. We need 5 sheets of iron to patch it.

helping-franklin.player: Won't iron go all rusty with all the salt water around here?

helping-franklin.speaker: Franklin Caranos
helping-franklin.text: Yes, but it'll do for a few weeks, and we haven't the time or materials to do a proper job just now.

helping-franklin.player: Alrighty. So where do I get sheets of iron?

helping-franklin.speaker: Franklin Caranos
helping-franklin.text: I've got a press in my shred. You can use it to heat up some iron bars and roll them into sheets. You'll need to fill its firebox first - stick some logs in it and light them.

helping-franklin.speaker: Franklin Caranos
helping-franklin.text: When you've got 5 iron sheets, hammer them onto the damage wall.

helping-franklin.player: Why do I need to heat the bars? I've been cold- working metal all my life, and I've never bothered heating it.

helping-franklin.speaker: Franklin Caranos
helping-franklin.text: How odd! I'd have expected all your products to be horribly brittle.
If the player is not carrying a tinderbox:

steps.speaker: Franklin Caranos
steps.text: Anyway, take this tinderbox and get to work.
Tinderbox

steps.player: Thanks.

helping-franklin.text: If the player has a tinderbox:

steps.speaker: Franklin Caranos
steps.text: Anyway, off you go.

helping-franklin-attempting-to-flatten-i.player: It's not hot enough to work at the moment.

helping-franklin-using-the-tinderbox-or-.player: The firebox is at the other end of the machine!

helping-franklin-using-the-iron-bars-on-.player: I should probably try putting metal bars into the OTHER end of the machine.

helping-franklin-using-the-logs-on-the-f.text: The firebox of the press is now filled with wood.

options.text: I'm working on it.

steps.player: I'm working on it.

steps.speaker: Franklin Caranos
steps.text: Good, good.

options.text: I can't remember what you wanted me to do.

steps.player: I can't remember what you wanted me to do.

steps.speaker: Franklin Caranos
steps.text: Put some logs into the metal press in my shed, and light them. Then feed 5 iron bars into the press to roll them into sheets. After that, you'll need to hammer them onto the damaged wall.

helping-franklin-using-the-tinderbox-on-.text: The press is now hot enough to process iron.

helping-franklin-using-an-iron-bar-on-th.text: You press an iron bar into a sheet of iron.

helping-franklin-using-an-iron-sheet-on-.text: The iron sheet is not changed in any way.

helping-franklin-using-any-other-item-on.player: I'm not putting that into the press! I don't want to break it!

helping-franklin-talking-to-franklin-aft.player: Well, the press is working now, but I still have to patch [the broken sections/[Amount] more bits of wall/the last piece of wall].

helping-franklin-talking-to-franklin-aft.text: With no sheets in inventory and no repaired walls:

steps.speaker: Franklin Caranos
steps.text: I hope you don't have too much trouble with that press.
If the player doesn't have a hammer:

steps.player: Also I think I need a hammer.

steps.speaker: Franklin Caranos
steps.text: Hammer? Not a problem - here's mine.
Hammer

helping-franklin-talking-to-franklin-aft.text: After making some sheets or repairing some walls:

steps.speaker: Franklin Caranos
steps.text: I think you'll need to make [[Amount] more/another] iron [sheets/sheet] first.
If the player doesn't have a hammer:

helping-franklin-talking-to-franklin-aft.text: With the correct amount of sheets:

steps.speaker: Franklin Caranos
steps.text: At least you've got enough iron sheets.
If the player doesn't have a hammer:

helping-franklin-using-iron-sheet-on-the.text: The section of the wall is now fixed.

helping-franklin-using-hammer-on-the-bro.text: You feel a lot calmer now, but it didn't achieve anything else. Maybe you should be using the iron sheet on the wall instead.

helping-franklin-using-any-other-item-on.player: I don't think that will help.

helping-franklin-using-iron-sheet-on-an-.player: This bit of wall is fine. I don't need to mess around with it now.

helping-franklin-using-hammer-on-an-alre.text: You feel a lot calmer now, but it didn't achieve anything else.

helping-franklin-using-iron-sheet-on-fra.speaker: Franklin Caranos
helping-franklin-using-iron-sheet-on-fra.text: You should be sticking the sheets to the wall, not to me!

helping-franklin-talking-to-franklin-aft.player: I've fixed all 5 bits of wall.

steps.speaker: Franklin Caranos
steps.text: Wonderful - thank you very much! Now you can turn your full attention to help Arnold...

steps.speaker: Franklin Caranos
steps.text: Oh, and if you've got any of those iron sheets left, I'll be happy to buy them off you once the Colony is safe.

steps.player: This is turning into a lot of work...

steps.speaker: Franklin Caranos
steps.text: Wonderful - thank you very much! You should return to my brother, Herman, and tell him you've finished helping me and Arnold.

steps.speaker: Franklin Caranos
steps.text: Oh, and if you've got any of those iron sheets left, I'll be happy to buy them off you once the Colony is safe.

steps.player: Oh good. Now maybe Herman will give me that reward he mentioned!

helping-arnold.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
helping-arnold.text: You come to speak to me, [player name]?

helping-arnold.player: Yes... Herman said you needed me to do something?

helping-arnold.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
helping-arnold.text: Ah, that is good. I the storemaster am for this Piscatoris Fishing Colony, and our stores are - ahah - not so good. Indeed, our stores contain not a bit of food!

helping-arnold.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
helping-arnold.text: This a catastrophe may become, as difficult it may be to fish while the trolls outside are waiting, and our bellies soon shall rumble loudly!

helping-arnold.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
helping-arnold.text: But now you come here to help Arnold! A good and sturdy warrior you must be indeed to have entered our Colony in these times! So you can the fishing do for us!

helping-arnold.player: You want me to catch fish?

helping-arnold.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
helping-arnold.text: Ja, this is so. But the fish must then be stored, or stinking rotten they become! So the fish you bring must be shiny fresh!

helping-arnold.player: Where do I get fresh fish?

helping-arnold.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
helping-arnold.text: The monkfish in these waters swim, this is why Herr Caranos build his Colony here.

helping-arnold.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
helping-arnold.text: You go catch 5 fresh monkfish from sea over in north- west corner. If you bring stinking old monkfish, Arnold know about it, and Arnold not take them!
If the player does not have a net:

steps.player: I'll need a net or something like that.

steps.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
steps.text: Ja, is not a problem.
Small fishing net

helping-arnold.player: Ok, five fresh monkfish coming up.

helping-arnold.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
helping-arnold.text: Big thanks, [player name]. When Colony safe, Herman reward you good.

helping-arnold-attempting-to-take-fish-f.player: I think I should maybe catch my own.

steps.player: No, I haven't got any.

steps.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
steps.text: Well, you go to sea at north-west corner of Colony and catch nice fresh monkfish for Arnold, ja?

steps.player: Ok.

helping-arnold-talking-to-arnold-again.text: With the wrong type of fish:

steps.player: I've got this fish...

steps.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
steps.text: That not monkfish! Go to sea at north-west corner of Colony and catch MONKFISH!
Your activity attracts a sea troll!
Your activity attracts a bigger sea troll!
Your activity attracts an even bigger sea troll!

helping-arnold-talking-to-arnold-after-f.player: Arnold, I've got some monkfish for you.

steps.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
steps.text: This? This fresh, but it no good to me raw! You go use range in kitchen!

steps.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
steps.text: Ah, lovely fresh monkfish straight from the sea! Now you bring me [amount] more, ja?

steps.player: Right, right.

helping-arnold-talking-to-arnold-after-f.text: After giving Arnold all 5 cooked monkfish:

steps.text: Before helping Franklin:

steps.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
steps.text: This is superb, [player name]! Now I store these carefully, and you go help little Frankie.
After helping Franklin:

steps.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
steps.text: This is superb, [player name]! Now I store these carefully, and you go tell Herr Caranos.

steps.player: Oh good, maybe he'll reward me now.

helping-arnold-talking-to-arnold-before-.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
helping-arnold-talking-to-arnold-before-.text: Your fresh monkfish superb! But now you go help little Frankie, ja?

helping-arnold-talking-to-arnold-after-h.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
helping-arnold-talking-to-arnold-after-h.text: Now you done helping me and Frankie, you go see what Herr Caranos want next.

helping-arnold-talking-to-franklin-after.speaker: Franklin Caranos
helping-arnold-talking-to-franklin-after.text: Now you've finished helping me and Arnold, you should see if Herman's got anything else for you to do.

back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.player: I've finished helping Franklin and Arnold now.
Does this mean you're going to reward me now?

back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.speaker: Herman Caranos
back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.text: There's something else I need you to do first.

back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.speaker: Herman Caranos
back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.text: Well, the Wise Old Man and I have discussed the situation, and he's come up with a plan...

back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.speaker: Wise Old Man
back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.text: Yes, that's right. The sheer number of trolls means that the best hope for the Colony is to gather our forces and wipe out all the trolls at once.

back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.player: Well, that sounds like a nice plan. One big fight, no more trolls.

back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.speaker: Wise Old Man
back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.text: Yes, with the bit about gathering our forces.

back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.player: Let me guess - you haven't got any forces to gather!

back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.speaker: Herman Caranos
back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.text: I sent most of the colonists away for their own safety when the trolls started attacking the Colony.

back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.speaker: Wise Old Man
back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.text: So what you need to do, [player name], is to fetch us an army!

back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.speaker: Wise Old Man
back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.text: In the Wizards' Guild in Yanille, Wizard Frumscone always seems to have a limitless supply of zombies and similar creatures. If you can persuade him to lend us an army, we should be able to defeat these trolls.

back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman.player: Ok, so I just need to go see Wizard Frumscone in Yanille?

back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman-aga.speaker: Herman Caranos
back-to-herman-talking-to-the-herman-aga.text: [player name] - have you brought an army?

options.text: No, I'm afraid I haven't asked Wizard Frumscone yet.

steps.player: No, I'm afraid I haven't asked Wizard Frumscone yet.

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Do get a move on, [player name]!

options.text: What was it you asked me to do?

steps.player: What was it you asked me to do?

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Go to the Wizards' Guild in Yanille and ask Wizard Frumscone to lend us an army to save the Colony!

steps.player: Right, I know it was something like that.

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Do get a move on, [player name]!

back-to-herman-talking-to-franklin-again.speaker: Franklin Caranos
back-to-herman-talking-to-franklin-again.text: Thanks a lot for your help earlier, but I have a lot to do, so please excuse me...

back-to-herman-talking-to-arnold-again.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
back-to-herman-talking-to-arnold-again.text: It good to see you, [player name], but many things I have to do with lovely fresh monkfish you bring me earlier.

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
talking-to-wizard-frumscone.text: Do you like my magic Zombies? Feel free to kill them, there's plenty more where these came from!

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.player: Hello. I need your help with something...

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
talking-to-wizard-frumscone.text: Oho? Very well, young man, what can I do for you?

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.player: The Piscatoris Fishing Colony, somewhere north of the Gnome Stronghold, is under attack by sea trolls, and they've sent me to ask for an army.

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
talking-to-wizard-frumscone.text: An army, heh? But I haven't GOT an army!

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.player: They said you might lend us some of your zombies.

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
talking-to-wizard-frumscone.text: What? This is a combat training facility, not a library! My magic zombies are not for loan.

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.player: So you can't help the Colony?

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
talking-to-wizard-frumscone.text: I'm jolly well not lending them an army! If I did that for you, I'd have to do that for everyone, and I'd never get a moment's peace again!

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.player: So what should I tell the Colony? They've got to give up all their work because you won't help?

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
talking-to-wizard-frumscone.text: Actually that does seem rather harsh...

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
talking-to-wizard-frumscone.text: Now, you mustn't breathe a word of this to Zavistic or Disentor upstairs, but I know a man who could help you get an army.

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.player: Great! Is he a Guild wizard too?

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
talking-to-wizard-frumscone.text: No, his work is completely different. He's a necromancer.

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.player: Necromancy? I don't want anything to do with that!

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
talking-to-wizard-frumscone.text: He's not going to have you doing any of the actual spellcasting for it. You'll probably just have to collect some weird item from him and take it to the Colony.

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.player: I don't know if I still want to do this.

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
talking-to-wizard-frumscone.text: If you don't want to continue the quest, just walk away and think no more about it. But I'm sure you won't have to do anything evil or unnatural yourself.

talking-to-wizard-frumscone.prompt: What would you like to say?

options.text: Enough of this - I'm off.

steps.player: Enough of this - I'm off.

steps.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
steps.text: Understandable. But if you ever change your mind, just come and ask me.

options.text: I'll see what the necromancer needs me to do.

steps.player: I'll see what the necromancer needs me to do.

steps.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
steps.text: Excellent. His name's Malignius Mortifer. You'll find him somewhere south of Falador.

steps.player: Can't I ask a different necromancer? There's one not so far away.

steps.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
steps.text: Hah! Necromancers aren't helpful people. I don't know of many - most guild wizards won't have anything to do with their practices. I think Malignius will help only because he loves showing off his powers.

talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-f.player: You said you knew a man who could help me save the Piscatoris Fishing Colony.

talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-f.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-f.text: Oh yes. Now, you mustn't mention this to Zavistic or Distentor, but he's a necromancer.

talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-f.player: Necromancy? I don't want anything to do with that!

talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-f.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-f.text: Do you like my magic Zombies? Feel free to kill them, there's plenty more where these came from!

talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-f.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-f.text: [player name]? Have you spoken to Malignius Mortifer?

talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-f.speaker: Wizard Frumscone
talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-f.text: He'll probably still be wandering around south of Falador whenever you do want to speak to him.

talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-h.speaker: Herman Caranos
talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-h.text: [player name] - have you brought an army?

talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-h.player: Wizard Frumscone wouldn't help, but he told me where I could find a wizard who might help. I have to look for him just south of Falador.
By the way, where's the Wise Old Man gone?

talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-h.speaker: Herman Caranos
talking-to-wizard-frumscone-talking-to-h.text: He said he'd be back in a minute. But never mind him - go to Falador and talk to this wizard!

talking-to-malignius-mortifer.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
talking-to-malignius-mortifer.text: So, [player name], your curiosity leads you to speak to me?

options.text: Who are you and what are you doing here?
I need help with saving a fishing colony.

steps.player: I need help with saving a fishing colony.

steps.text: If the player is wearing equipment aligned with Saradomin:

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Not when you're dressed like that! I don't help Saradominist filth!

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Hahaha! You want MY help? HAHAHA!

steps.player: ... um... The Piscatoris Fishing Colony needs an army to defend them against attacking trolls.

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: And of all the people in the world, you came to ask ME? HAHAHA!

steps.player: ... um... pretty please?

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Oh, I'll help! I'll give you GOOD help!

steps.player: ... um... thanks, I think...

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: An army, eh? I can raise you a lovely army of the undead skeletal magi! That'd be just right, wouldn't it?

steps.player: I'm not going to have to do anything... evil, am I?

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: No, I'll keep the fun bits for myself. You'll just have to get a few things for me.

steps.player: Alright - what do you need?

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Firstly, I need 7 bones, the normal sort you get from people and small monsters.
With no bones in inventory:
If the player already has the bones:

steps.player: I have some here!

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Hah! And I thought only necromancers and jogres carried bones around with them! Very well, hand 'em over.

steps.player: What should I do now for the quest?

steps.text: (Continues below)

options.text: About those enchanted secateurs again...
Where can I get clothes like those?
About those enchanted secateurs again...
What was it you said you'd need to help me save the Colony?

steps.player: What was it you said you'd need to help me save the Colony?

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Bones! I need bones, the normal sort you get from humans and small monsters. If you're having trouble, go to the highwaymen just north of here - they've got bones!

steps.player: Oh yes, how could I have forgotten?

options.text: Where can I get clothes like those?

talking-to-malignius-mortifer-giving-bon.player: I have some bones for you.

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Good. Now I need [Amount] more.

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Excellent!

steps.player: What should I do now for the quest?

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: From the bones you have given me, I shall make bone seeds. These will contain the essence of your army. But you will need some way to carry the seeds.

steps.player: What had you in mind?

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: You must go to the Crafting Guild to ask the advice of the master crafters. There are quite a few of them there, and one of them's sure to help.
If the player has a brown apron:
If the player does not have a brown apron

steps.player: I doubt they'll let me in there without a brown apron.

steps.text: Brown apron

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Here, take this one.

steps.player: Thanks!

options.text: Could you spare me a brown apron?
options.condition: If the player lost their apron:

steps.player: Can you spare me a brown apron so I can go to the Crafting Guild to ask the master crafters about transporting bone seeds?

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Yes, yes.

steps.player: Thanks!

options.text: What am I meant to be doing for the Colony?

steps.player: What am I meant to be doing for the Colony?

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Is there something wrong with your memory? I told you to go to the Crafting Guild to ask the master crafters for advice on transporting bone seeds.

talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-a.speaker: Master Crafter
talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-a.text: Hello, and welcome to the Crafting Guild. Accomplished crafters from all over the land come here to use our top notch workshops.

talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-a.player: Can you tell me anything about transporting bone seeds?

talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-a.speaker: Master Crafter
talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-a.text: Bone seeds? What are bone seeds?

talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-a.player: A necromancer is going to bind the essence of an undead army into some bone seeds for me if I can get a container to carry them in.

talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.player: Can you tell me anything about transporting bone seeds?

talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.speaker: Master Crafter
talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.text: Woah dude! That's, like, some seriously maximum stuff you're talking.

talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.player: But do you know what I should carry them in?

talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.speaker: Master Crafter
talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.text: Yeah, you just need a pot with a lid. Do you know how to make pot lids?

talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.player: Yes, a woman called Tassie taught me.

talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.speaker: Master Crafter
talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.text: Tassie Slipcast? She's one groovy lady.

talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.player: Yes, yes, very nice. So if I get a pot with a lid, I'll be able to carry bone seeds safely in it?

talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.speaker: Master Crafter
talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.text: Yeah, yeah. You need to chill out more, dude.

talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.player: What was it you said I needed for transporting bone seeds?

talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.speaker: Master Crafter
talking-to-a-master-crafter-talking-to-t.text: A pot with a lid. Nothing more, nothing less.

options.text: About those enchanted secateurs again...
I've spoken to the master crafter...

steps.player: I've spoken to the master crafter about a container for transporting bone seeds.

steps.text: If the player is wearing equipment aligned with Saradomin:

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: You can take that Saradominist attire off before you try speaking to me about your quest again!

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Ah, excellent. HAHAHA! Have you got such a container?
If the player doesn't have a pot and pot lid:

steps.player: No, I haven't got one.

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Then get one!
If the player has a pot and pot lid:

steps.player: Yes, I have it here.

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: I have raised you an army and bound them into bone seeds for you!

steps.player: ... um... Thanks!

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Don't mention it, it was fun! HAHAHA!

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Now I will seal the seeds into your pot.
Bone seeds

steps.player: Thank you. So what do I do with them?

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Take the pot to the Colony and open it! HAHAHA! Just don't open it before you get there.

steps.player: Suppose I - ahem - need another one later?

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Bring me another of these pots with a lid and I will give you more bone seeds.
Malignius unexpectedly casts a spell on you.
Malignius unexpectedly casts a spell on you!

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: HAHAHA!
The player is teleported to the Fishing Colony

options.text: Where can I get clothes like those?

chatting-before-the-final-battle-talking.speaker: Franklin Caranos
chatting-before-the-final-battle-talking.text: Herman tells me you've been fetching us an army.

chatting-before-the-final-battle-talking.speaker: Franklin Caranos
chatting-before-the-final-battle-talking.text: Interesting. I didn't know magic could do that.

chatting-before-the-final-battle-talking.player: You learn something new every day.

chatting-before-the-final-battle-talking.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
chatting-before-the-final-battle-talking.text: [player name]! I hear you fetch mighty army for us!

chatting-before-the-final-battle-talking.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
chatting-before-the-final-battle-talking.text: You go take them to Herr Caranos quickly!

the-final-battle.speaker: Herman Caranos
the-final-battle.text: [player name] - have you brought an army?

the-final-battle.player: No, really, the wizard told me he'd put bone seeds in this pot, and when I opened it the army would come forth from the bone seeds.

the-final-battle.speaker: Wise Old Man
the-final-battle.text: Hmmmph. I don't much like the sound of this. I certainly won't be sending anyone to Frumscone for help again!

the-final-battle.speaker: Herman Caranos
the-final-battle.text: You can talk about that later! Now we've got an army we can get on with beating the trolls!

the-final-battle.speaker: Wise Old Man
the-final-battle.text: Well, I suppose so. [player name], this could be VERY dangerous. Do you feel ready to fight?

the-final-battle.player: Aren't you going to do the fighting?

the-final-battle.speaker: Wise Old Man
the-final-battle.text: Yes, of course. But you, my trusty sidekick, are in this adventure with me, and if I'm going forth into battle, you should make sure you're ready too.

options.text: I'm ready. Let's fight!

steps.player: I'm ready. Let's fight!

steps.speaker: Wise Old Man
steps.text: Good. May this, my final adventure, end well!
Cutscene begins

options.text: I'd like to get some stuff together first.

steps.player: I'd like to get some stuff together first.

steps.speaker: Herman Caranos
steps.text: Come back to us as soon as you're ready.

the-final-battle-final-battle-cutscene.text: A cutscene opens by showing the player opening the jar, causing an army of skeleton magi to appear and fight off the incoming sea trolls.
A sea troll general appears from the ocean.
The Wise Old Man does battle with the sea troll general, deftly avoiding its strikes before finishing it off with his powerful magic.
A spell flies in from off-screen, hitting the Wise Old Man, knocking him to the ground. The Sea Troll Queen appears.

the-final-battle-final-battle-cutscene.speaker: Wise Old Man
the-final-battle-final-battle-cutscene.text: I... can't... move... [player name], you must fight this for me...

the-final-battle-entering-the-colony-wit.prompt: Do you need to see the battle again?

options.text: Yes, I missed it. Show me the battle again.
No, I'm ready to move on with the quest.

steps.text: The player is transported in front of the queen.

finishing-up-after-killing-the-sea-troll.player: Now I've killed that THING, Herman's sure to reward me!

finishing-up-talking-to-arnold.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
finishing-up-talking-to-arnold.text: You kick big troll queenie pretty hard, ja?

finishing-up-talking-to-arnold.player: Yes, I don't think you'll have any more trouble with the trolls in future.

finishing-up-talking-to-arnold.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
finishing-up-talking-to-arnold.text: Piscatoris Colony owe you big-time for your help. You go see Hermie - maybe he got something for you.

finishing-up-talking-to-arnold.speaker: Arnold Lydspor
finishing-up-talking-to-arnold.text: Herr Herman Caranos. I call him 'Hermie' when him not listening. Sometimes I call him worse things, but not today.

finishing-up-talking-to-franklin.speaker: Franklin Caranos
finishing-up-talking-to-franklin.text: I say, you certainly gave that Troll Queen a good thrashing!

finishing-up-talking-to-franklin.player: Yes, no more trouble from her.

finishing-up-talking-to-franklin.speaker: Franklin Caranos
finishing-up-talking-to-franklin.text: I think Herman would like to talk to you in his office. We all owe you so much.

finishing-up-talking-to-franklin.player: Ok, I'll go and see Herman.

finishing-up-talking-to-ramara-du-croiss.speaker: Ramara du Croissant
finishing-up-talking-to-ramara-du-croiss.text: [player name]? Monsieur Caranos wishes to see you in 'is office. Please, go to 'im!

finishing-up-talking-to-everyone-else.speaker: Everyone else
finishing-up-talking-to-everyone-else.text: [player name]? Mr Caranos said he wanted to see you in his office. I wouldn't keep him waiting if I were you!

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.player: I've defeated the Sea Troll Queen!

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Wise Old Man
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: Your fight was truly magnificent, [player name]! Congratulations!

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Herman Caranos
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: [player name], how can I ever thank you? You have saved my Fishing Colony from utter destruction!

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.player: Well, you mentioned something about a reward?

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Herman Caranos
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: Of course, of course!

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Wise Old Man
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: I think you've earned a little something from me, too.

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.player: Ooh, goody! Thanks, old man! Um... can I have your hat?

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Wise Old Man
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: 'Old man'... yes, I am old. That creature nearly killed me - I have never been so close to defeat.

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.player: Aww, cheer up - we won! But can I have your hat as my reward?

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Wise Old Man
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: Yes, we won... YOU won... It is definitely time I retired.

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.player: So that's the end of your adventuring? Also, how about that hat of yours?

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Wise Old Man
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: Well, I'm sure I'll find some way to keep myself busy. But yes, this has been my last quest. My swan song.

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.player: It's been... nice working with you! It'd be even nicer if you'd give me that hat...

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Wise Old Man
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: It's been a pleasure working with you too. Do pop in to see me in Draynor soon! I leave you with my blessing...
The Wise Old Man teleports away.

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Herman Caranos
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: Oh, he's gone. I hope he enjoys his retirement.

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.player: HE DIDN'T GIVE ME HIS HAT!

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: Player performs the Cry emote.

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Herman Caranos
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: It's only a hat!
Player performs the Headbang emote.

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.player: Anyway, you were going to reward me too?

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Herman Caranos
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: Oh yes, of course! You are hereby welcome to visit the Piscatoris Fishing Colony at any time and make full use of our fishing spots!

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.player: Why is it better to fish here than in Catherby or the Fishing Guild?

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Herman Caranos
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: Ah, I'm glad you asked that! You see, this is the only known place where you can catch monkfish!

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.player: Ok, so I can catch monkfish. Um... thanks?!

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Herman Caranos
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: Yes - there's good eating on a monkfish. They heal more health than the swordfish and lobsters most adventurers carry around, but they're easier to catch than sharks.

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.player: I suppose that could be useful.

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Herman Caranos
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: Indeed! I'm sure Arnold will help you send your monkfish to your bank account. Also, seaweed accumulates in the nets down by the shore, which you might find useful. Franklin says it's much quicker than trying to gather it on Entrana.

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.player: Maybe if I ever want to do glassblowing again...

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Herman Caranos
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: Finally, I'd like to give you a little token of my thanks.
25000 Coins

finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.speaker: Herman Caranos
finishing-up-talking-to-herman-one-last-.text: No, thank YOU!
Congratulations! Quest complete!
